title: Sources: the EU is negotiating with China to lift sanctions on an unnamed Chinese company in exchange for China lifting sanctions on a German ASML supplier (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Sources: the EU is negotiating with China to lift sanctions on an unnamed Chinese company in exchange for China lifting sanctions on a German ASML supplier — The European Union is in talks with China to secure relief from sanctions that threatened the survival of Sindlhauser Materials GmbH …
